title: IO & do-notation
hints: README 'New syntax': `do` blocks, `forM_` for loops, `pure` to return a value, `sequence` to run a list of actions, `when` for a conditional action.

countdown: loop over a descending range printing each number, then print liftoff!. greetAll: loop printing the greeting, then return the count. sumActions: run them all with sequence, then return the sum. whenLoud: `when` the flag is set, print the uppercased message.
Other data: `forM_ [10, 8 .. 2] print` · `forM_ ws $ \w -> putStrLn (w ++ \"!\")` · `do { xs <- sequence [pure 1, pure 2]; pure (sum xs) }`.
`countdown n = do { forM_ [n, n - 1 .. 1] print; putStrLn "liftoff!" }` · greetAll ends with `pure (length names)` · `whenLoud flag msg = when flag (putStrLn (map toUpper msg))`.
